International Returns Management System v1.0.0 – initial launch.

- Parses user input to generate actionable recommendations specific to target markets and product categories.
- Delivers comprehensive JSON output with analysis, framework guidance, and safety disclaimers.
- Enforces descriptive boundaries: no transactions, bookings, real-time data, or code execution.
